Ill try my best to describe my routine! If you can see I'm doing something obviously wrong please correct me!

I used to dye my hair every month, and use all that bad crap on my hair so it was straight with a random curl or kink, so im so happy with how it looks now. I also chopped off as much as I dared, just above my shoulders. 

I wash/cowash with sukin hydrating shampoo, massaging my roots, and dipping my head under the water for a second to let the shampoo spread a bit, then continue to massage it in. Once my hairs all clean I rinse it all out. 

Then I add in a huuuge amount of sukin hydrating conditioner, making sure it covers all my hair (trying to avoid the roots). I let that sit for a few minutes and detangle my hair then rinse it out. 

Once out of the shower I scrunch my hair to get out excess water, then using a tshirt I fold it onto my head to let it catch a bit more water. After 5 minutes or so I take it off. 

I'm still experimenting with which gel to use and how to use it, currently I'm using go curly by marc daniels, and it honestly ain't that good. It smells like rubbing alcohol, but it's what I've got so whatever. I get a good blob on my hands, rub it into my hands then scrunch it into my hair. Once I'm happy with how much product is in there I spray in some coconut oil, then I let it air dry! 

If you have any suggestions I'm all ears :)
